confirmedCause.mechanism: Installed Playwright treats the Promise returned by an async waitForFunction predicate as truthy before resolving its boolean. A false result returns a false handle after one evaluation instead of polling.

confirmedCause.controlledResponseDelay: The actual intercepted first upload is released into its response handler, but delivery of its unchanged 200 JSON is held behind a second gate. The original wait returns false, then the unchanged assertion reads syncing with no URL and fails exactly as CI did.
confirmedCause.afterRelease: Real 200 response and JSON consumption precede a native one-URL checkpoint; queued owner_mismatch writes retain that URL. No failed fetch or later empty overwrite was observed.
